evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies src/node/block_template_manager.*, src/interfaces/mining.h, and src/node/miner.* to manage block template thread safety and expose getTotalFees().
rationale: Fixes a ThreadSanitizer data race where concurrent IPC worker calls race between submitSolution() and template getters like getBlockHeader(). Protecting m_block_template with a mutex and releasing it before blocking waits eliminates undefined behavior and ensures template integrity for external mining consumers.
